description: Test suite for exec-safe-bins helper functions in the 'doctor' command, testing scanning, reporting, and profile scaffolding for safe binary execution environments.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Setup function from vitest to run after each test case.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite grouping related test cases.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion method from vitest for defining expectations.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within a test suite.

methods.name: scanExecSafeBinCoverage
methods.description: Scans configuration for potentially unsafe or missing profiles for binaries.

methods.name: collectExecSafeBinCoverageWarnings
methods.description: Generates warning messages based on scan results regarding bin coverage.

methods.name: maybeRepairExecSafeBinProfiles
methods.description: Attempts to scaffold or suggest profiles for safeBins to improve security.

methods.name: scanExecSafeBinTrustedDirHints
methods.description: Checks if safeBins resolve outside trusted directories and warns.

methods.name: collectExecSafeBinTrustedDirHintWarnings
methods.description: Creates warning messages based on trusted directory hints.
